# @luxalgo/vela

> Vela is a charting library for financial charts: a headless chart core with a WebGL renderer,
> a full chart app (`VelaWorkspace`: one chart or a grid), data providers, a plugin SDK, and a
> component kit with one typed theme config (`@luxalgo/vela-ui`, installed with it). Scripting
> engines are separate packages (Pine Script: `@luxalgo/vela-pinets`).

Start with `VelaWorkspace` from `@luxalgo/vela/workspace` for a chart app, or `Vela` from
`@luxalgo/vela` for the chart surface alone. Charts run in the browser; give the container a
height. Themes come from `createTheme` (`@luxalgo/vela`).

## Skills (agent instructions in this package)

- [building-vela-charts](skills/building-vela-charts/SKILL.md): charts, data providers,
  indicators, themes and saved state.
- [using-vela-data-providers](skills/using-vela-data-providers/SKILL.md): the bundled
  providers, symbol routing, and writing a provider for any source.
- [adding-vela-indicators](skills/adding-vela-indicators/SKILL.md): built-in studies, Pine
  Script through an engine, native indicators, scripting engines, new built-in studies.
- [using-vela-drawing-tools](skills/using-vela-drawing-tools/SKILL.md): the drawing toolbar,
  drawings from code, saving them, and adding a drawing tool to Vela.
- [extending-vela-with-plugins](skills/extending-vela-with-plugins/SKILL.md): buttons, menu
  rows, panels, overlays, chart types and renderer layers through the plugin SDK.
- [upgrading-vela](skills/upgrading-vela/SKILL.md): moving a project from 0.9 to 0.10.
- The UI kit ships three more in `node_modules/@luxalgo/vela-ui/skills/`: using its components,
  theming, and writing components.

Link them into a project's coding agent with `npx skills experimental_sync` once the package is
installed, or install them from the repository with `npx skills add LuxAlgo/Vela`.

## Guides (in this package)

- [Quickstart](docs/user/quickstart.md): a chart on screen, an engine, an indicator.
- [The workspace](docs/user/workspace.md): layouts, cells, sync, persistence, the topbar and the
  sidebar.
- [Options](docs/user/options.md): every chart option.
- [API reference](docs/user/api-reference.md): the chart's methods, events and control surfaces.
- [Data providers](docs/user/data-providers.md): symbols, venues and the bundled providers.
- [Scripting engines](docs/user/scripting-engines.md): Pine Script and writing an engine.
- [Drawing tools](docs/user/drawing-tools.md), [Timeline marks](docs/user/timeline-marks.md),
  [Localization](docs/user/localization.md), [FAQ](docs/user/faq.md).
- [Upgrading](docs/user/upgrading.md): breaking changes and deprecated names, release by release.
- [Plugin SDK](docs/contributing/plugin-sdk.md): every extension hook.
- [Adding a data provider](docs/contributing/adding-a-data-provider.md),
  [Adding a scripting engine](docs/contributing/adding-an-engine.md),
  [Adding a drawing tool](docs/contributing/adding-a-drawing-tool.md).
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md).

## The UI kit

`node_modules/@luxalgo/vela-ui/llms.txt` indexes the kit: its component manifest, theme schema,
guides and skills.
